english.legislation: Contrary to section 88(6) and (8) of the Automated Vehicles Act 2024.

english.notes:
(i) The Automated Vehicles (Permits for Automated Passenger Services) Regulations 2026 authorises recipients of certain information to share it with other persons for specified purposes, or use it for purposes other than the purpose for which it was obtained, without this offence being committed. This includes for service information, accident investigation, emergency response, public safety, enforcement, legal proceedings, compliance, or handling complaints. The regulations also provide broader disclosure powers for the Secretary of State and emergency services. For further information, see regulation 10.
(ii) Section 88(6) of the Automated Vehicles Act 2024 provides defences of consent, reasonable belief or previous lawful disclosure.
